subject: Pilot: Hands-on Lab + Customer Panel with Stride Consulting
messages:
From: Ellie Park <ellie@strideconsulting.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: partnerships@strideconsulting.com
Date: 2026-10-25T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot: Hands-on Lab + Customer Panel with Stride Consulting

Hi Karthik / Soojin,

Nice to meet you both (virtually). Quick intro — I’m Ellie, Head of Partnerships at Stride Consulting. We’ve been working with three joint customers who implemented Redwood’s dedicated deployment to run large-scale retrieval-augmented generation, and our delivery team has been asking for an opportunity to showcase the operational wins (latency drops, cost per 1M tokens, and rollout cadence) alongside Redwood’s engineering best practices.

We’d like to propose a compact pilot: a 60-minute hybrid session (30-minute hands-on lab + 25-minute customer panel + 5-minute closing) targeted at platform engineers and AI/ML engineering managers. Goals:
- Demonstrate a simple repo + infra checklist for private deployments
- Show real metrics from Stride’s rollout with a customer (anonymized)
- Provide a short Q&A + call-to-action (trial, field consult)

We can cover co-marketing cost for light promo and provide a small honorarium for customer participants. Attached is a one-page SOW and a proposed run-of-show.

Possible dates: week of Nov 15 or Nov 29 (we’re flexible). Would Redwood field an engineer and a product speaker? Also — who on your team handles logistics/Promotion (copy, registration page, tracking)?

Thanks — excited about a low-friction pilot to validate interest.

Cheers,
Ellie Park
Head of Partnerships | Stride Consulting
ellie@strideconsulting.com
attachment: RDWD_Stride_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 92KB)
attachment: pilot-run-of-show.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Ellie Park <ellie@strideconsulting.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-26T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Hands-on Lab + Customer Panel with Stride Consulting

Thanks Ellie — great to hear from you and congrats to your delivery team on the success. We’re keen. A few quick notes from our side: 

1) Speakers: I can take the engineering/ops segment (short talk on inference economics and deployment checklist). Soojin can cover product features and rollout patterns. We’ll want 1-2 customer voices — curious which customer you’re thinking of and whether they’re available for a panel.

2) Logistics & Promotion: looping in Marissa (alliances) for co-marketing and Ben (field marketing) for registration / promo assets and lead routing. Marissa — can you own the registration page + landing copy? Ben — we’ll need a HubSpot event (tracking id), 2 promotional emails (announcement + reminder), and an event recording workflow.

3) Technical prep: would like the hands-on to be runnable in a 20–30 minute window. If Stride can provide a small repo (Terraform + sample app) that uses a Redwood Private deployment or a mocked endpoint, we’ll shape the lab to be beginner-friendly. Please confirm whether we should expect live access to a customer instance or run against a demo environment.

4) Budget / SOW: I’ll review the SOW and come back with any edits. One ask — can you include an outline of the anonymized metrics you plan to present (latency and cost comparisons, timeframe, traffic pattern)?

Proposed tentative date: Nov 17 (Wednesday) or Nov 30 (Tuesday). If either works we’ll lock speaker availability.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

On Mon, Oct 26, 2026 at 09:42 AM Ellie Park <ellie@strideconsulting.com> wrote:
> Thanks — attaching a short SOW and proposed run-of-show. Customer is an enterprise retail chain (they agreed to anonymized metrics). We can do Nov 17 or Nov 30, Nov 17 is slightly preferred for them.
>
> — Ellie
>
> attachment: pilot-run-of-show.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)
From: Ellie Park <ellie@strideconsulting.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-27T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Hands-on Lab + Customer Panel with Stride Consulting

Karthik — thanks for the quick reply and for looping in Marissa/Ben. Quick clarifications: 

• Customer panel: confirmed — anonymized metrics from a retail customer (traffic windows Nov 2025–May 2026). We’ll share a short metrics deck (no PII) and agree script for the panel.
• Hands-on repo: Stride will publish a trimmed repo (Terraform + small Node app + local mock) to a private GitHub repo and invite the Redwood speakers. That will let the hands-on run against a demo endpoint to avoid touching a customer instance.
• Promo & budget: we can commit $3k co-marketing to cover paid social + list rentals and provide the small honorarium for customer speakers. SOW attached includes line items and payment terms.

If Nov 17 works, we propose this timeline:
- Nov 2: Draft landing page copy + promo assets due
- Nov 5: Registration page live
- Nov 10: Speaker slide deck drafts due (Redwood + Stride)
- Nov 15: Tech/run-through + dress rehearsal
- Nov 17: Event day

Please confirm and we’ll get legal looped for the SOW signature.

Best,
Ellie

attachment: RDWD_Stride_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 92KB)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: 2026-11-01T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Hands-on Lab + Customer Panel with Stride Consulting

Thanks — I’ll take the ops on promo and registration. Quick notes from Marketing: 

• HubSpot event: creating HS-48391. Will use the standard co-marketing form and route leads to Partnerships > Field > Sales Ops. Ben — would you add the tracking snippet for the registration page once live?
• Copy & assets: I’ll draft announcement copy + event description (short, technical-first). I’ll need: 1–2 speaker bios (200 words max), a short metrics summary line we can include on the landing page, and the final run-of-show.
• Recording & deliverables: We will record and produce a 4-minute highlight clip + full recording to gated on-demand page. Need confirmation on who owns editing (Stride or Redwood).

I’ll upload draft copy to the shared Drive folder and share access. Also tagging Legal to review SOW — we prefer a simple DPA addendum for anonymized metrics.

Marissa Cole
Alliances Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

All — quick operational update:

• HubSpot event HS-48391 is live as a draft; registration page will go live once Marissa posts final copy. I’ve added the registration webhook to route leads to the Partnerships queue and created a field to tag source=Stride_PartnerPilot.
• Recording: Redwood will own editing and publish the highlight clip; Stride can share any on-brand b-roll or customer-provided clips for inclusion.
• Run-of-show tweaks: suggest moving Q&A to end of session (10–12 minutes) and having a moderator screen the audience questions to keep it technical. I updated the run-of-show and attached a spreadsheet with timeboxes.

Next steps: Marissa — landing copy by Nov 2 (as discussed) so we can test the registration flow. Ellie — please send invite to the private GitHub and the anonymized metrics deck by Nov 5. Legal will circulate a one-page addendum for the SOW — Karthik, I’ll flag if anything needs sign-off from you.

— Ben
